saw_lines: Magnesium buyers pick a product for one problem, like tight temples or sore legs, and reorder it once it works.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where the problem gets named and the offer should appear.
Your site offers Extra 10% OFF on Prepaid, yet 0 of 27 copy ads mention it. Put that offer in line one of three new ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers Extra 10% OFF on Prepaid, yet 0 of 27 copy ads mention it, so a first buyer has no reason to act. Put that offer in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

0 of 27 copy ads carry a proof number, so a viewer has nothing to trust before the click. Collect one figure, a review count or orders shipped, and open three new ads with that number on the creative.

3 of your 27 copy ads are creator posts run from the brand page, so a customer’s review reads as a company ad and loses its pull. Whitelist those three from the creator account, then cut three variations of each.

Your 27 copy ads use 18 openings, and the biggest, “some reviews just feel real”, leads 3. No single story gets repeated enough to build recognition. Build the next batch from the two strongest, the review and tightness openers.

ads_1: Review and tightness openers, with the prepaid 10% offer in line one
